answers.core: It's a matter of coherence and consistency in UIs, and it would not be very easy to add through an addon as it has to do with the node's rendering itself.
answers.workaround:
I used a shader, which has limitations and can get very complicated to write. Another way is duplicating the Control node, changing color and shifting it, but more often than not it works terribly.
I think it'd be used often and can't be easily worked around.

title: Make text_shadow property in Control nodes consistent
